title: Optional tape-cell write
statement: Let $t$ be a tape assigning each integer position either a Boolean value or no value, and let $j$ be an integer position. Given an optional write instruction whose content is itself either a Boolean value or no value, the resulting tape is $t$ if there is no instruction; otherwise it agrees with $t$ away from $j$ and has the instructed content at $j$.
hypotheses_covered: A tape is a function from the integers to optional Boolean values
The target position is an integer
The instructed content is an optional Boolean value
